rationale: The original thesis relied on price accelerating down beneath the 5-minute 9-EMA ($14.59 at entry, now $14.60), yet the most recent 1-minute candle broke and closed solidly above it at $14.64 on strong volume after buyers defended the $14.54-$14.55 area. With only 18 minutes left in the session and SPY up nearly 5%, the downward momentum has failed, justifying an immediate exit to preserve capital rather than waiting for the $14.69 stop to be hit.
